=== BACKTEST — model accuracy on completed cycles ===
Each forecast is frozen at the close of the UTC day before that cycle's halving, using only
cycles completed before it. MVRV Upside/Downside need a future turning point, so they are not scored.
Cycle high = highest close within 2y of the halving; low = lowest close AFTER that high. Error = (predicted / actual - 1) x 100.
Quality labels (good <20% · ok <40% · poor) are shown only when n >= 3.
